name: Fixed-point Amanatides–Woo Grid Traversal
definition: Fixed-point implementation of Amanatides–Woo using 16-bit signed integers with 8 fractional bits (Q8.8).
summary: Fixed-point Amanatides–Woo Grid Traversal uses Q8.8 fixed-point arithmetic to efficiently traverse 2D grid cells, avoiding floating-point operations and rounding errors inherent in pure integer methods.
